vanillaAndReact.runtime: actual packaged Wasm; real vanilla/React mounts and paired persistence with synthetic DOM, IndexedDB and Web Locks
contracts: Explicit document/selection targets; literal HTML-looking comment text is not interpreted as markup.
Keyed reply/edit fields retain drafts and focus through native peer updates.
Stale edits need explicit current-discussion acknowledgement before native save.
Resolve/reopen and separate native comment history.
Aborted version persistence retries the existing captured version without duplication.
Pure native restore preview, source-change invalidation and explicit Apply.
Current comments survive restore and become orphaned/reattached through document Undo.
Native permissions reject a stale host display claim without losing its draft.
DOM disposal retains existing host content and the borrowed native owner.
React StrictMode and parent renders preserve draft/owner identity; unmount does not close either writer.

reproducedAndRepaired.issue: SDK review guards originally compared only revision strings, so another facade with equal document/review revisions could reuse one.
reproducedAndRepaired.before: The actual-Wasm matching-revision cross-owner test failed with Missing expected exception.
reproducedAndRepaired.repair: A frozen facade-lifetime object witness is part of every live review guard and checked before dispatch. Native Rust opaque observations already had exact owner identity.
reproducedAndRepaired.after: Foreign-owner and JSON-copied guards reject; the current owner's unchanged policy remains a valid no-op. All three actual-Wasm probes pass.
